description: Return the Starcovery page that asks the person to give a member of the caller's organization the owner, admin, or member role, in their signed-in browser. Opening the page changes nothing. No setting turns an owner back into an admin or a member. Only owners and admins may call it. Needs a credential.

memberId.description: Member id from the members of get_organization

role.description: owner, admin, or member; no setting turns an owner back into an admin or a member

name: change_member_role

next.description: What the person does on the page to finish

url.description: The Starcovery page that opens this action prefilled, for the person to confirm in a browser signed in to Starcovery. Opening it changes nothing.

title: Change member role
